claims.text: Many reviewers report visible improvements in skin smoothness, firmness, and reduced cellulite appearance after using the cream for a few weeks to a couple of months.
Several reviewers describe the cream as easy to apply, light, smooth-spreading, and long-lasting per tube.
A few reviewers note the product reduces but does not completely eliminate cellulite.
Some reviewers express disappointment, saying the product did not work for them or that the tube did not last as long as stated.
One reviewer questions the credibility of the positive reviews, claiming none were verified purchases and all received the product for free.
